messages:
maria: FYI - OrbitLabs UK invoice inv_2026_0999 failed during checkout: 3DS authentication timed out. Gateway shows auth_flow=3DS, status=timed_out. Card last4=3005, billing_country=GB, bin_country=US. Can payments ops triage?
payments-bot: alert: payment_failed invoice=inv_2026_0999 attempt=1 reason=3ds_timeout gateway=checkout-eu auth_flow=3DS bin_country=US billing_country=GB last4=3005
jon: On it. Two hypotheses: (A) issuer blocks cross-border 3DS UX, causing timeout; (B) customer's browser blocked the 3DS popup. Ops will replay the 3DS session link if still valid.
nora: Amount ~£9,600. Finance: do we want to pre-authorize wire fallback for amounts close to 10k to reduce churn? We can approve on case-by-case but need KYC + sales signoff.
maria: Support says customer tried from a corporate workstation with strict popup blockers. They asked for immediate payment options to avoid service interruption.
ashley: Created ticket S-9765: https://zendesk.redwood/s/9765. Reached out asking customer to (1) retry in incognito or mobile, or (2) switch to card via a different card, or (3) accept wire. Pausing billing emails until resolved.
jon: Ops playbook: if 3DS link still valid, run: 
```bash
# replay 3DS iframe for customer
curl -X POST https://api.redwood/payments/replay-3ds -d '{"invoice_id":"inv_2026_0999","channel":"email"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $PAYMENT_OPS_TOKEN'
```
jon: If replay not possible, we can attempt a manual auth (card-present style via acquirer) but that requires payments-risk approval.
nora: Finance note: prefer wire if customer confirms they can pay today and want guaranteed settlement. For £9,600 we need: (1) wire PR form submitted, (2) KYC docs, (3) sales confirmation. Use https://internal.redwood/finance/wires and cc finance@redwood.
maria: Could sales do a quick outreach offering a lower-friction option: one-click card link (hosted pay) + temporary invoice hold? Sales: @oliver can you confirm?
ashley: Pinged sales (oliver) in ticket. Also included hosted pay link instructions and one-click hosted pay script. Ticket updated.
support-bot: Customer responded - prefers wire. Provided company registration + VAT. Requests bank details.
nora: Great. Finance will fast-track once PR + KYC attached. Maria, please confirm internal approval to proceed.
maria: I approve proceeding with wire for this case. Ask customer to include beneficiary name exactly as on registration. Nora, I'll loop legal if any export restrictions apply.
jon: Ops note: once payment method is switched to wire run this command to update invoice: 
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood/payments/update-invoice -d '{"invoice_id":"inv_2026_0999","payment_method":"wire","status":"pending_manual_payment"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $PAYMENT_OPS_TOKEN'
```
nora: I'll watch for PR and release payment after bank verification. Finance will not recognize revenue until cleared in bank.
maria: Next actions summarized: support to get wire confirmation & bank details (ashley), ops to try 3DS replay once more if customer prefers card (jon), finance to approve wire on PR + KYC and release once verified (nora). Following up in 2 hours. :thumbsup:
